page.overview:
Who is Erit?

Erit was an Andorian Starfleet medical officer and friend of Julian Bashir. They attended Starfleet Medical Academy together.

Elizabeth Lense mistakenly believed Bashir was Andorian after someone incorrectly pointed out Erit as Bashir to her at a New Year's Eve party in 2367 hosted by Bruce Lucier. She did not learn the truth until she met Bashir on Deep Space 9 in 2371. ()
